name: Regime-armed long-horizon trend on BTC/ETH only (capacity-light gate, not majors-beta)
rationale: THESIS: The cleanest macro->crypto coupling is on the two assets institutions actually price off macro — BTC and ETH — not the long alt tail whose moves are dominated by idiosyncratic token flow. A risk-on macro_regime (BOUNDED FRED composite, next-day) should arm a SLOW 30d trend specifically on BTC/ETH, where the regime signal is least diluted by token noise and the swing horizon keeps taker churn far under 10bps. min_instruments=5 still holds because the universe is screened, but the thesis is that the gate's lift concentrates in the majors. DISCONFIRMERS (two): (1) run the SAME regime-armed 30d trend on a BTC+ETH-only screen vs the broad 8-asset universe — if broad matches, the lift is generic majors-beta diversification, not BTC/ETH macro coupling; (2) drop the macro_regime gate on the same assets — if trend-alone matches, the regime adds nothing. The gate must add net-of-fee Sharpe AND the majors-concentration must beat the broad universe to confirm the coupling thesis.
catalyst: Macro regime composite above its risk-on floor while a 30d trend on the macro-coupled majors is up — the slow trend is armed only inside the open macro window.
